title: SMK Bolt Grey

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The SMK Helmets SMK Bolt Grey is crafted for classic motorcycle enthusiasts seeking unrestricted peripheral sightlines, pairing 180-degree panoramic sightlines with certified cranial protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing a featherweight 1286g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~96 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. The interior features a plush, moisture-wicking crown liner shaped for Intermediate Oval head shapes, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for effortless warm-weather riding.

product_details.description: SMK Bolt open face with inner visor.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with pressure-relief temple channels and contoured removable cheek pads.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the SMK Helmets SMK Bolt Grey: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in SMK Helmets's Open Face lineup, the SMK Bolt Grey brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The SMK Helmets SMK Bolt Grey represents SMK Helmets's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~96 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Open Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the SMK Helmets SMK Bolt Grey delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
